finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: if the packet contains maliciously crafted input
finding.assumptions: The packet content is attacker-controlled and the printf function does not sanitize the input properly.

finding.title: Buffer Overflow
finding.trigger: if the received packet size exceeds 4096 bytes
finding.assumptions: The packet size is not checked before copying it into the fixed-size packet buffer.
